caches.notes: Deno's OS cache-dir convention for macOS; not present on this machine. Also holds location_data/<hash>/kv.sqlite3 and localStorage — persistent Deno.Kv/localStorage state, not only a module download cache. ask.env sets DENO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 so being asked never checks for a newer Deno release (https://docs.deno.com/runtime/reference/env_variables/).
